explication: HEY CLI is a terminal client for HEY email and calendar, with a full-screen TUI and integrations for coding agents. The main workflow starts at the CLI, uses stored authentication to perform mail or calendar actions, and presents results as terminal-friendly or machine-readable output. README capabilities also include live updates, contact and journal views, sender screening, and agent access through setup and MCP. Source excerpts are incomplete, so some feature relationships are documented rather than traced through implementation.
